lines.text: The Teacher saw a righteous man perish in his righteousness, and he who fears God will follow both warnings.
Wisdom makes the wise man stronger than seven rulers, and no righteous man on earth does good and never sins.
The Teacher says not to heed every word spoken, since you know you have cursed others many times yourself.
The Teacher tested all this by wisdom, but it was beyond him, and he searched out wisdom and explanations.
Among a hundred the Teacher found one upright man, and he found that God made mankind upright.
